description:
Role summary:
At Differential Bio, our mission is to unlock the potential of the bioeconomy by fixing how biological R&D and scale-up are done.
We’re looking for a Machine Learning Data Scientist to join our growing cutting-edge modelling team. You will develop novel machine learning algorithms and mechanistic models of bioprocess systems and push them from research proof-of-concept into production-ready commercial use.
This role is focused on research, including creating hybrid models that combine mechanistic and machine learning approaches to predict how microbial fermentations behave, and that keep working when we move to a new organism, a new sensor, or a larger reactor. You’ll play an instrumental role on two existing grants and work with leading academic groups and industrial partners on pilot- and production-scale data. In addition, you’ll develop new research projects and drive them to completion and application on customer projects.
We’re interested in researchers who want their work to end up in real bioreactors and are excited about working at an early-stage startup. You should be comfortable owning hard, open-ended problems where nobody has the answer yet, making evidence-based decisions under uncertainty, and shipping real solutions.
How you’ll work
You’ll collaborate with technical leads and academic/industry external partners to design and execute research that meets our commitments in both consortia and strengthens our own platform.

You’ll own your research…

If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.
Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital vehicle designed to carry cargo and, in the longer term, potentially crew.
To support the ramp-up of our production activities in Munich, we are looking for a Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) Technician - Level 2 with strong practical experience in radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT). Ultrasonic testing (UT) experience is an advantage.
You will perform and document inspections on critical space components and assemblies. In your day-to-day work, you will collaborate with Production, Quality and Engineering teams, as well as external providers and the appointed Responsible Level 3. Your rigor will directly contribute to the conformity, traceability and reliability of flight hardware.

Your mission
You will prepare and perform NDT inspections in accordance with approved procedures and acceptance criteria, assess results within the scope of your qualification, and alert the relevant stakeholders when you identify a discrepancy or technical concern.

What you will do
Perform radiographic testing (RT/X-ray) and penetrant testing (PT) on production parts, welds, structures and other hardware in accordance with applicable procedures.

Prepare parts, verify inspection conditions, and use the required equipment and consumables.

description:
Aufgaben
Was du machst
PALU ist in Deutschland und Österreich etabliert, jetzt bereiten wir den nächsten großen Wachstumsschritt vor: einen neuen Markt. Als Founders Associate übernimmst du das Projekt, das darüber entscheidet, wie wir ihn angehen. Du baust die Lieferkette für den neuen Markt auf und prüfst, ob unser Business Plan für die Expansion aufgeht.
Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Gründer, bekommst ein klares Ziel und bestimmst den Weg dorthin selbst. Am Ende steht eine belastbare Antwort, auf die wir eine Investitionsentscheidung bauen.
Was das konkret bedeutet:
Lieferkette aufbauen: Du findest und qualifizierst internationale Hersteller, Spediteure und Fulfillment-Partner und verhandelst mit ihnen.

Jeden Kostenpunkt kennen: Du baust ein Landed-Cost-Modell mit Produktion, Fracht, Zöllen, Lager, Last Mile und Retouren. Danach weißt du, was uns ein Bett im Zielmarkt wirklich kostet.

Business Plan validieren: Du gleichst Annahmen mit echten Angeboten ab, rechnest Szenarien durch und sagst klar, wo der Plan hält und wo nicht.

Risiken früh erkennen: Produktsicherheit, Zertifizierungen, Zölle. Du klärst, was wir wissen müssen, bevor es teuer wird.

Investor-ready machen: Du erstellst Modelle, Tabellen und Slides, mit denen wir die Expansion vor Investoren vertreten.

Das ist kein Praktikum, bei dem du Recherche-Ordner füllst. Du verantwortest das Ergebnis.

Resonance is an applied AI company. We have recently raised one of the largest ever European seed rounds, with investment from Anthropic and Hg Capital. We believe the economic diffusion of AI is the major challenge of the next decade. Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

description:
About Griffin
Hi, we’re Griffin. We’re a fully regulated UK bank that powers the accounts and payments offerings of product-led fintechs and platforms like Uber, Yonder, Prosper, and Sidekick. By doing the heavy lifting behind the scenes, our customers can focus on what they do best - delivering amazing customer experiences.
We’ve grown rapidly since our launch in 2024, and today provide the banking backbone behind products in remittance, payroll, wealth, insurance, proptech, payments, neobanking and more.
We’re moving into card issuing, stablecoin infrastructure, and agentic finance next as we continue to support the next generation of product-led companies.
Learn more about what we do

Our culture
We believe that smart, motivated, conscientious people thrive in high-trust, high-autonomy environments and have done our best to create such an environment at Griffin. People who thrive here don’t require much hand-holding, and go out of their way to figure out how to contribute in the most valuable way possible.
We've been remote-first since we were established in 2017 and we remain so today. Work here is asynchronous and fully flexible - because we want to be a part of your life in a way that helps you to get the most out of both your work and home life.

description:
Our Mission:
Scope automates the data collection that's slowing down the physical world.
Standards are vital for the safety of our infrastructure. Spending hours manually documenting them is not.
Dave is an inspector. Today he’s climbing through one of Europe’s biggest chemical plants, looking for the corrosion that could shut the whole site down, with a notebook and pen in hand. Tomorrow, he’ll spend even longer on the part of the job he hates: turning those scribbles into a report.
We’re building the AI-native data collection layer for the 2 billion field workers like Dave. Scope radically simplifies how inspectors collect data in the field, make decisions, and produce reports. Along the way, we’re building the largest dataset on the condition of the built world and the decisions experts make about it.
It’s a $2T market and we’re just getting started. We're growing rapidly, and already work with 7 of the top 10 companies in the space. Our customers inspect facilities and products for companies including AstraZeneca and SpaceX.
We take pride in our talent density, and have assembled a best-in-class team: acquired and future founders, people from institutions like Imperial, Carnegie Mellon and Oxford, and from firms like Palantir, Goldman Sachs and Flexport .
Since launching from Entrepreneurs First in 2024, we've raised an oversubscribed $20m round led by Index Ventures, the firm behind Figma, Revolut and Wiz, with over 100 unicorns backed to date.

Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation.

Dans le cadre du projet CARBURE (projet DGA Rapid mené en partenariat avec la société eXO maKina), qui vise l'explicabilité de la prise de décision dans la lutte contre la falsification d'images à partir de réseaux profonds, nous recrutons une ingénieure ou un ingénieur de recherche et développement au sein de notre Département Sciences des Données.

En collaboration avec l’équipe du projet et les équipes de recherche partenaires, vous aurez pour mission principale de développer un outil d'accompagnement à l'analyse et à l'explicabilité de la falsification d'images. Vous concevrez une architecture reposant sur des RAGs multimodaux spécialisés (liés à l'interprétation des filtres du logiciel Tungstène) et assurerez leur synthèse dynamique. Vous mettrez également en place un démonstrateur (PoC) autonome fonctionnant hors réseau et valoriserez ces travaux par la rédaction de livrables techniques et de publications scientifiques.

Rattachée à la Head of HR Operations, le/la HR Data & Social Controlling Analyst assure le pilotage de la masse salariale et des effectifs, tout en développant une approche analytique et data-driven de la fonction RH.
Il/elle garantit la fiabilité des données sociales, contribue à la construction et au suivi du budget RH, automatise les reportings et transforme les données RH en analyses pertinentes en étroite collaboration avec la Direction Financière.

Élaborer les prévisions actualisées (forecasts) et les projections de fin d'année.

Analyser les écarts entre réalisé, budget et prévisions, et identifier les principaux facteurs explicatifs.

Modéliser les effets des évolutions d'effectifs, des augmentations salariales, des promotions, des bonus, des départs et des recrutements.

Réaliser des simulations financières pour accompagner les décisions RH : recrutements, réorganisations, politiques de rémunération et évolution des effectifs.

Suivre les principaux indicateurs économiques et sociaux : masse salariale, effectifs, rémunération moyenne, coûts des recrutements et autres coûts RH.

Contribuer à l'amélioration des processus de contrôle et de fiabilisation des données de paie et de rémunération.

About Voodoo
Founded in 2013, Voodoo is a tech company that creates mobile games and apps with a mission to entertain the world. Gathering 800 employees, 7 billion downloads, and over 200 million active users, Voodoo is the #3 mobile publisher worldwide in terms of downloads after Google and Meta. Our portfolio includes chart-topping games like Mob Control and Block Jam, alongside popular apps such as BeReal and Wizz.

Team
At BeReal, we are dedicated to authenticity in social media. By encouraging users to share unfiltered moments, we foster genuine connections and celebrate real life. We are now an international team of 100+ and have 40M+ monthly active users. Backed by Voodoo, our team is fully focused on scaling BeReal into an iconic social network used by hundreds of millions.

Role
We’ve built BeReal with a tiny technology team of world-class engineers and we intend to keep this mindset as we scale it to hundreds of millions of users. To achieve this, we ship new features faster than any other scaled social network while upgrading our infrastructure. We work in small teams of generalists and give each engineer high autonomy to make product related decisions.
Tackle exciting technical challenges, given the nature of our product, which experiences spikes of millions of users connecting within a 2-minute window.

Contribute to the development of a robust architecture capable of supporting massive scale as we attract new users and expand to new countries.

summary: About Prelude Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever. Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes…
description:
About Prelude
Prelude is redefining how companies authenticate and onboard users - turning what's traditionally a cost center into a growth lever.
Our flagship product lets businesses send OTP codes with the best price-to-conversion ratio on the market, dynamically selecting the most effective channel in real time (optimized SMS, WhatsApp, and more) while actively blocking spam and fraud that legacy providers miss.
Founded in 2022 by former Zenly team members who lived the pain of broken SMS authentication firsthand, we're already serving fast-growing companies across Europe and are expanding into the US. 
But authentication is only the starting point - we're building the platform for trust at scale, with an ambitious roadmap of market-defining products ahead.
Why join us
Today, we're a team of 60 and growing, based in Paris, building products that power secure and high-performance user onboarding for companies across the world. We believe small, highly skilled teams outperform large, fragmented organizations, and we are intentional about staying focused on impact, quality, and speed.
We operate with a flat org structure and value in-person collaboration, which helps ideas move faster, decisions stay grounded, and teams take full ownership of what they build.
Our values 
Care
We care deeply about our customers, our teammates, and the quality and reliability of what we ship.

Bias for Action
We move fast, test in the real world, and iterate quickly rather than over-optimizing…

Senior Stack Scientist
About EH Energy Engineering
EH Energy develops fuel cell technology for heavy-duty mobility and large-scale stationary power. Our redesigned fuel cell is more compact, has higher power density and costs less to produce. We build high-performance, cost-effective fuel cell solutions to help address climate change and the move toward decentralised energy.
As Senior Stack Scientist, you will own the scientific understanding of how our stacks perform and age. You will connect cell-level electrochemistry with stack-level design, operating conditions and manufacturing, and turn that understanding into stacks with higher power density, longer life and repeatable performance.

Key Responsibilities
Lead stack-level performance and durability investigations, from short stacks to full-size stacks.

Define and run stack test campaigns: polarisation, EIS, cell voltage monitoring, durability and accelerated stress tests under realistic duty cycles.

Analyse water management, thermal behaviour, gas distribution and cell-to-cell uniformity, and identify what limits performance.

Investigate stack degradation and failure modes, including post-mortem analysis, and lead root-cause work with the materials, process and design teams.

Develop and validate stack models (electrochemical, thermal, fluidic) to guide design choices and operating strategies.

description:
Over Nedlin
Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Als groeiend B-Corp familiebedrijf investeren we graag in jong talent en versterken we de verbinding tussen onderwijs en arbeidsmarkt. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

De stageopdracht
Tijdens deze hbo-stage ga je aan de slag met Lock Out Tag Out (LOTO). LOTO is een veiligheidsmethode waarbij machines en energiebronnen tijdens onderhoud of werkzaamheden veilig worden uitgeschakeld en vergrendeld. Zo wordt voorkomen dat een machine onverwacht wordt ingeschakeld terwijl eraan wordt gewerkt. Jij helpt Nedlin om deze werkwijze verder te ontwikkelen, te standaardiseren en praktisch toepasbaar te maken.

Je onderzoekt de huidige LOTO-werkwijze en brengt risico’s, energiebronnen en isolatiepunten in kaart.

Je ontwikkelt een uniforme LOTO-procedure en machine-specifieke LOTO-kaarten.

Je brengt de benodigde materialen en hulpmiddelen in kaart.

Je ontwikkelt instructie- en toolboxmateriaal voor medewerkers.

Je stelt een praktisch implementatieadvies op om LOTO binnen Nedlin verder te borgen.

Wat bieden wij?

Nedlin is een industriële textielverzorger voor Healthcare, Hospitality en Industry, waar veiligheid, kwaliteit, continu verbeteren en verantwoord ondernemen centraal staan. Daarom bieden we studenten de kans om praktijkervaring op te doen, zich te ontwikkelen en Nedlin te leren kennen, met waar mogelijk mooie doorgroeikansen na het afstuderen.

Onderzoek hoe Customer Service slimmer en efficiënter kan omgaan met klantcontact via e-mail en telefoon. Je brengt de huidige werkwijze in kaart en onderzoekt hoe AI, automatisering en slimme tooling…

description:
👋🏻 Hello, we're Laka
You might not have heard of us yet - that's OK, you've found us now - come and find out more about our journey...
Founded in 2017, Laka set out to transform insurance by connecting passionate cyclists to form a collective and protect their bikes for when things go wrong - a better model for insurance was born. For once people come first in insurance by fairly sharing the cost amongst each other. We exist to rewrite the rules of insurance so it’s something people stand with, not against.
Our model: Laka makes sure everything runs smoothly for The Collective - from exceptionally fast claims, splitting the cost fairly, guaranteeing a maximum price and all the other heavy lifting of a regulated insurance business. For that service, the collective pays Laka a fee relative to the claims in a month.
Take a closer look at exactly what this means and how it works here.
What have we been up to since then...?
In a nutshell, we've been very busy! Here are a few of the massive achievements we've had:
🚀 Raised $10.4 million at series B!
🚀 Grown the team to over 60 Lakanauts, based across the UK and NL, enabling a choice-based, remote-first way of working
🚀 Launched Laka in a total of 11 countries, essentially helping more people in more places!
🚀 Captured the UK and NL enthusiast cyclist market and expanded into commercial business partnering
🚀 Been awarded 'Best Cycle Insurance Provider' (for the past 8 years in a row - go us! 🥳)

IT Medewerker – Eerste Lijns Service Engineer

Ben jij die IT-held die energie krijgt van het helpen van mensen, houdt van virtuele omgevingen en SaaS-oplossingen, en een passie heeft voor techniek? Dan zouden we zomaar eens een match kunnen zijn.

Wie zoeken we?
We zijn op zoek naar een Eerste Lijns Service Engineer / Servicedesk Medewerker die klanten op een vriendelijke én deskundige manier verder helpt. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt bij IT-vragen of problemen . Zo weet je bijvoorbeeld wat het verschil is tussen een TAC en TAC 2 LAN netwerk of je kan rechten correct toewijzen in SharePoint. Of je nu net van school komt of al wat meters hebt gemaakt in de IT: we horen graag van je.

Wie zijn wij?
Welkom bij Progression IT. Wij zijn een hecht en ambitieus IT-bedrijf uit Terneuzen, Zeeland. Al sinds 2005 helpen we onze klanten met slimme, veilige en toekomstgerichte IT-oplossingen. We doen dat met een enthousiast team van 25 collega’s – stuk voor stuk vakmensen met hart voor hun werk én voor elkaar.

description:
ad/mbo-praktijkstage, vanaf februari 2027
Ben jij iemand die graag orde schept in de chaos? 
Krijg je energie van uitzoeken, structureren en dingen overzichtelijk maken? 
Werk je graag met digitale systemen?

Dit is jouw uitdaging
We hebben honderden documenten met informatie over ons beleid en genomen besluiten. Deze documenten zijn relevant voor veel collega’s. Om die reden willen we de documenten graag op een overzichtelijke manier aanbieden, zodat alle collega’s snel en makkelijk het document kunnen vinden dat ze zoeken. We hebben al een idee hoe we dit willen gaan doen. Tijdens jouw stage ga je ons idee verder uitwerken en in de praktijk toepassen.
Dit zijn de concrete activiteiten:
Je gaat alle beleidsdocumenten verzamelen die nu nog op verschillende plekken zijn opgeslagen.

Je maakt een mappenstructuur aan, waarin de documenten op een logische plek komen te staan.

Je deelt de documenten in volgens de nieuwe structuur en voorziet ze van labels en metadata voor een optimale vindbaarheid.

Je controleert of documenten dubbel voorkomen en verwijdert dubbele, verouderde en niet meer relevante documenten.

Je kijkt of de nieuwe structuur in de praktijk goed werkt en of gebruikers de documenten gemakkelijk kunnen terugvinden.

Je signaleert knelpunten en doet waar nodig voorstellen voor verbeteringen.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role

Samsara is a leader in a dynamic market. As a public company listed on the NYSE with $2.1B in ARR, we deliver mission-critical solutions to physical operations globally. This position is tailored for high-performing professionals seeking to accelerate their professional growth. summary: Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het…
description:
Als Accounts Payable & Financial Controller ben je medeverantwoordelijk voor de juistheid, volledigheid en tijdigheid van onze financiële administratie — een van de belangrijkste pijlers voor het nemen van beslissingen binnen Crisp. Je combineert de dagelijkse sturing op de crediteurenadministratie met uitdagende controlewerkzaamheden, data-analyses en het automatiseren van onze processen met behulp van moderne tools en AI.
Wat je gaat doen
Je werkt elke dag met een gezellig team vol gedreven mensen. We hebben ervaring in business control, accounting, corporate finance, data analytics, fiscaal recht en auditing. Crisp groeit snel, en de verantwoordelijkheden van ons team dus ook. Zo is geen dag hetzelfde en blijven we onszelf continu ontwikkelen. We sparren veel en staan open voor elkaars mening.
Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het verwerken en controleren van inkomende facturen en declaraties. Je staat leveranciers te woord, beheert de mailstroom en zet betalingen klaar.

description:
About Flexport: 

At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. 

The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.

description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are
About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

As an early member of the Bridge engineering team, you'll have the autonomy to work on projects that are truly global in scale and aim to give customers access to products they've never had access to. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Airbnb's Online Data organization gives every engineer at Airbnb the power to build real-time data experiences — through simple, intuitive tools, without needing deep database expertise.

Within Online Data, the Storage Foundation team owns the online serving stores and databases that power Airbnb. We build and operate Airbnb's source-of-truth database: an open-source, distributed NewSQL system running on stateful Kubernetes. It stores critical data — users, listings, and more — and handles over half of all of Airbnb's online OLTP traffic. Our charter: keep this database reliable, secure, scalable, fast, correct, well-tested, and cost-efficient — at Airbnb's scale.

The Community You Will Join

We're hiring two roles within the Database team. Both are described below.

Database Performance & Reliability: Dig into the internals of a large-scale, multi-tenant, distributed database — storage, query execution, consensus, change data capture, and shard routing and management. You'll root-cause hard performance, reliability, and stability issues, and partner directly with our open-source database vendor to land fixes…

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb’s Data Infrastructure organization builds the platforms that power data across the company. Within it, the Data Movement & Transformation (DMT) pillar builds the platform that moves data between Airbnb’s storage engines and transforms it along the way.

Today, data moves through many bespoke, one-off pipelines that are built and maintained differently by each team. We’re replacing them with one unified, declarative platform. You define data once, and it is replicated everywhere it needs to go. This work underpins Airbnb’s Data as a Service initiative.

You’ll join the team that owns three connected layers of that platform:

Control plane: the layer that turns declarative data definitions into running pipelines, including provisioning, runtime selection, and lifecycle management.

Schema: how schemas are defined, tracked, and evolved safely across every system and engine.

Realtime Data Infrastructure (RTDI): Kafka and the streaming transport layer that real-time data flows through at scale.

As a Staff Software Engineer, you’ll set technical direction across these layers and stay…

Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low-latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants. Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The newly formed Conversation Platform team aims to build a conversation platform for all merchants who use Stripe. We are doing so by (a) automating the easy tasks, and (b) assisting our users in the difficult tasks. Some examples include customizing the Stripe landing page to suggest bespoke integrations, allowing users to command the Stripe API in natural language, and resolving user issues automatically. We are developing RAG based systems on the latest LLMs as well as fine-tuning our own models. We’re an end-to-end team going from ideas to models to shipping in production.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities

Driving an ambitious vision for AI/ML that benefits our users

Setting the technical & process direction for the team based on business goals

Brainstorm and coordinate product integrations with partner teams

Proposing new ideas and building prototypes

About the team

The Billing organization at Stripe builds and operates Stripe Billing, a growing product vertical inside of Stripe. Hundreds of thousands of businesses of all sizes and types use Stripe Billing to collect revenue for recurring and one-time payments across a variety of different pricing models—from selling SaaS subscriptions, to orchestrating multi-stage contracts, delivering business analytics, and providing recovery and retention tools to prevent customer churn.

To support even the most unique and complex business models, our technology and products must be configurable and programmable. This requires our team to innovate in how we model different types of businesses, and how we use technology to enable customers to piece together Stripe’s Billing’s platform primitives into holistic solutions that support any type of business. About the team

The Checkout Optimization team is the growth team for Stripe’s checkout UIs. They build high-converting, personalized checkout experiences for buyers and agents, as well as the data platform that powers it. 

The team identifies opportunities to improve checkout through rapid product experimentation and delivers optimization at scale through our ML-powered engine. The team also builds the reliable data foundations that enable this work, including experimentation, optimization, and data-informed product decisions across Stripe’s checkout suite.

Over the next 6 to 12 months, the team will focus on:

Building personalized checkout experiences powered by the ML-based Optimization Engine

Agentic commerce through optimizing OCS experiences for agent buyers

Checkout optimization for rapidly growing AI companies

Improving our data platform, which is critical to leveraging data internally and externally
